description: This PHP class defines a parameter structure for updating module data in the API. It extends a base parameter class and uses Symfony's OptionsResolver to configure expected parameters such as 'type', 'id', and 'attributes'.

classes.name: UpdateModuleDataParams
classes.description: A parameter class for handling update module data requests, allowing configuration and access to parameters such as 'type', 'id', and 'attributes'.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the module being updated.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the specific module instance.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Returns the attributes for the update, or an empty array if none are set.

methods.name: configureParameters
methods.description: Configures the expected parameters using Symfony's OptionsResolver to enforce valid options.
